doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Recording the Ukrainian choir on the Mulaney episode
summary: On the night after Russia invaded Ukraine he miked a choir with hidden mics borrowed via Lawrence Manchester, then switched to the band; the show earned an Emmy nomination.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Thank you. Yeah it was a really interesting show, it was the one hosted by John Mulaney last season and as far as one of the things that happens at SNL the night before was when Russia invaded Ukraine. And so there was this last minute pivot to have this local Ukranian choir from New York City open the show. And I made a rather concerted effort to get it sounding right rather than just put like a mic on a stand here and here and whatnot. And I was able through my colleague Lawrence Manchester down at the Tonight Show get a hold of some really great microphones. They have these nice little Sennheiser mics and I put a little X-Y thing underneath the table looking up at this choir so you don’t even see the mics, and then we had two mics and I’m using my camera here as this kind of thing (everything’s backwards) to be able to put mics just out of range of the choir looking in so that we had four mics but you couldn’t see them and it sounded lovely and then the big trick is to go when they say “Live from New York it’s Saturday night” and you have to switch your snapshot to open up the house band and not have those mics which are set for choir level all of a sudden pick up the sound of the drums. So

those sort of things make it a little nuts. And then we had this band, LCD Sound System on which couldn’t be more in the opposite direction of this choir, and we had a lot of other various complicated sketches with audio playback and singing and whatnot. So we all decided we would put this one in for consideration and lo and behold we got a nomination. So that news came yesterday and everyone texting back and forth, it’s probably why the internet was kind of slow yesterday because everyone was just back and forth you know.
